name: nlgeom-small-strain-hex20
reference: Benchmark K3. Benchmark B1's cantilever at a thousandth of its load, solved with `static-nonlinear` instead of `static`. The reference is the linear answer itself: at a tip deflection of 0.19 micrometres on a 1 m beam the geometric terms are of order 2e-7 relative, so the two procedures must agree to well inside that. The gate is the same 0.1904070 mm hex20 answer of B1 scaled by 1/1000, to 1e-5 relative. It is the cheapest possible check that the finite-strain kernel degenerates to the linear one - a wrong B_L, a missing geometric stiffness or the wrong strain measure would all still pass a large-deflection case within its 2 % gate, and none of them passes this.
